text:
alex: quick proposal — want to align on a rollout pattern for routing_v3 that minimizes customer impact. idea: staged regions -> shadow validations -> small canary -> progressive degradation steps with automatic fallback to model-v2. TL;DR in next msg.

alex: TL;DR: 1) enable shadow mode in 2 regions (eu-west-1, us-west-2) for 48h; 2) run automated shadow validations against canary prompt set; 3) if pass, open 5% canary in eu-west-1 + 1% in us-west-2 for 24h; 4) monitor latency, error-rate, quality-regression metrics; 5) if any metric breaches, trigger progressive degradation (reduce traffic slices -> fallback to model-v2) and page SRE.

maria: solid. add explicit pass/fail thresholds for quality and latency. also define who manually overrides progressive degrade.

sachin: suggested thresholds: latency p95 < 250ms, error-rate < 0.5% absolute, quality-regression (BLEU-like) delta < 1.5 pts on eval set. shadow validation should run full eval set nightly and summarise.

olivia: +1 to sachin. on the QA side we should include 2 customer-specific prompt families for regressions (payments, auth flows). shadow mode must log full inputs (redacted) to KMS-protected bucket.

jamal: ops note — ensure feature flag supports region slices and emergency kill switch. Also need autoscaling policy for canary to avoid cold-start errors.

alex: agreed. here's a sample flag payload we can use in LaunchDarkly/Flagsmith:

```json
{
  "flag": "routing_v3",
  "variants": ["v3", "v2-fallback"],
  "rules": [
    {"region": "eu-west-1", "pct": 5},
    {"region": "us-west-2", "pct": 1}
  ],
  "shadow_validation": true,
  "fallback_variant": "v2-fallback",
  "kill_switch": "/flags/routing_v3/kill"
}
```

maria: can we add an explicit "degrade_steps" array so the automation can step down like 5% -> 2% -> 0%?

sachin: yes, something like: [5,2,0] with wait windows [30m,15m] between steps. automation will also include a backoff if new errors spike.

alex: good. also proposing a short A/B to measure cost delta: during canary, run 10% of v3 traffic in real route and 10% in a mirrored cheaper-quantized variant. compare cost/token and quality.

olivia: that A/B needs consent from privacy for mirrored payloads. I'll loop in security and data-privacy.

jamal: blockers: we need a tracing hook to tag shadow requests and a Grafana dashboard with these panels: p95 latency, errors, quality-regression score, cost/token. I'll create a dashboard template.

alex: action items: @maria define pass/fail thresholds and gating doc (due EOD Thu); @sachin implement nightly shadow eval job + metrics export (due Mon); @jamal add kill-switch + dashboard template (due Fri); @olivia confirm data retention/consent with security (ASAP). I'll draft rollout doc and short playbook for oncall.

maria: noted. also propose preflight checklist: smoke tests across long-tail prompts, rate-limited synthetic load at canary pct, SIMULATE failure mode (e.g., slow KV cache) to ensure degrade works.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: build routing_v3-canary@2026-03-18T10:32Z -> deploying to eu-west-1 (5%) and us-west-2 (1%).

jamal: once deploy finishes, I'll run the smoke suite and post the logs in this thread. if anything looks off we flip kill-switch. :thumbsup:
